Itinerary

Day by day

1Day 1Arrival in Casablanca

Arrive at Casablanca airport. You’ll be greeted by your driver and transferred to your hotel to rest before starting your adventure. Later, enjoy a short city tour of Casablanca — the cosmopolitan heart of Morocco — including a visit to the impressive Hassan II Mosque, one of the largest in the world.

2Day 2Casablanca · Rabat · Volubilis · Fes

After breakfast, depart for Rabat, Morocco’s capital. Explore the historic medina, Kasbah of the Udayas, and Mausoleum of Mohammed V. Continue to Volubilis, a UNESCO World Heritage Site showcasing ancient Roman ruins and intricate mosaics. After visiting, head to Fes for dinner and overnight in a Riad.

3Day 3Fes guided tour

Discover Fes, Morocco’s cultural and spiritual capital. Wander the narrow streets of the ancient medina, visit the Bou Inania Madrasa, Nejjarine Fountain, tanneries, and Al Quaraouiyine University — the world’s oldest. Explore the Jewish quarter and admire the unique coexistence of cultures. Overnight in Fes.

4Day 4Fes · Ifrane · Azrou · Erfoud · Merzouga

After breakfast, travel toward the Sahara Desert. Pass through Ifrane, known as “the Moroccan Switzerland,” and the cedar forest of Azrou, where you can see wild Barbary apes. Stop for lunch in Midelt, then drive through the Ziz Valley before reaching Merzouga. Enjoy a camel ride into the dunes and a magical night under the stars in a desert camp with dinner and Berber music.

5Day 5Merzouga · Rissani souk · Toudgha Gorges · Dades

Wake up early to watch the sunrise over the dunes. After breakfast, visit Rissani — famous for its fossil workshops and lively souk. Continue through Tinghir to the magnificent Todgha Gorges for a scenic walk and lunch. End the day in Dades Valley, surrounded by beautiful rock formations. Overnight in a charming hotel.

6Day 6Dades · Ouarzazate · Ait Ben Haddou · Marrakech

After breakfast, drive through the Valley of Roses and Skoura oasis before arriving in Ouarzazate, the “Hollywood of Africa.” Visit Kasbah Taourirt and Atlas Film Studios. Continue to Ait Ben Haddou, a UNESCO-listed ksar and the setting for films like Game of Thrones and Gladiator. Cross the High Atlas Mountains via Tizi n’Tichka Pass (2260m) and reach Marrakech for overnight stay.

7Day 7Marrakech guided tour

Spend a full day exploring the Red City with a local guide. Visit Koutoubia Mosque, Bahia Palace, Saadian Tombs, El Badii Palace, Menara Gardens, and the colorful Majorelle Gardens. After lunch, explore the bustling souks and famous Jemaa El Fna square with snake charmers and street performers. Overnight in Marrakech.

8Day 8Transfer to airport

After breakfast, transfer to Marrakech or Casablanca Airport according to your flight schedule. End of your 8-Day Tour from Casablanca with Epic Travel Morocco — until next adventure!
